question: Will Rodri stay at Manchester City?
rules:
This market will resolve to the next team Rodri officially joins by September 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

If Rodri does not officially join a new team by September 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Manchester City".

If Rodri joins a team that is not listed, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Rodri is released, retires, or is not under contract with any professional team by September 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

An official transfer announcement prior to the market's close date will immediately resolve this market to the corresponding option.

The primary resolution sources for this market will be official announcements from Manchester City and/or the acquiring team. A consensus of credible media reporting may also be used to resolve the market.

evidence.excerpt: Real Madrid were expected to make an offer for Rodri and were believed to have made initial contact with Manchester City, according to Sky Sports News. Madrid were believed willing to pay £43 million–£51 million (€50 million–€60 million), given that he had one year left on his contract. City did not want to sell him and hoped to agree a new long-term contract.

AS reported that Rodri prioritized Real Madrid if he left Manchester City, despite interest from Barcelona and other clubs. Barcelona had approached his representatives but had not contacted City, according to SER. City were asking €75 million, while Madrid hoped to complete a deal for around €60 million. Madrid also needed at least one player departure to accommodate its planned signings.

question: Will Save the Children win the Nobel Peace Prize in 2026?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, as announced by the Norwegian Nobel Committee.

If multiple listed individuals or entities jointly receive the prize, the market will resolve to a single winner. If Donald Trump, Volodymyr Zelenskyy,  Benjamin Netanyahu, Vladimir Putin, or Elon Musk are among the recipients, the market will resolve to the highest-ranked among them in that exact order of precedence. If none of those five are among the winners and the prize is awarded jointly to at least one listed individual and at least one listed organization, the market will resolve in favor of the individual. If no prioritized individuals are among the winners and all listed recipients are of the same type (all individuals or all organizations), the market will resolve to the person whose last name, or the entity’s name, comes first in alphabetical order as listed in this market.

If no official announcement regarding the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize has been made by March 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other."

The resolution source for this market will be the first official announcement from the Norwegian Nobel Committee.

evidence.excerpt: PRIO Director's updated 2026 Nobel Peace Prize List includes Mykola Kuleba and Save the Children, Sudan’s Emergency Response Rooms, the Committee to Protect Journalists, the International Court of Justice and the International Criminal Court, and the International Space Station. Save the Children plays a central global role in preventing and responding to the United Nations’ six grave violations against children in conflict zones. Its protection programmes, advocacy and long-standing field presence demonstrate the critical importance of humanitarian organizations in safeguarding children and holding perpetrators accountable.

PRIO’s original 2026 list includes Mykola Kuleba and Save the Children, Sudan’s Emergency Response Rooms, the World Trade Organization, the Committee to Protect Journalists, and the International Court of Justice and International Criminal Court. Awarding the Nobel Peace Prize to Mykola Kuleba and Save the Children would highlight both the devastating impact of war on children and children’s agency in these settings. Awarding the Peace Prize to Save the Children would also emphasize the continuing need for multilateral approaches to peace.

As world leaders gather for the 81st United Nations General Assembly, Save the Children U.S. President and CEO Janti Soeripto is calling for greater urgency to protect children facing conflict, hunger and preventable disease. The Impact Alliance is a collaboration between Save the Children, CARE and Prosper Global designed to explore more connected, efficient and locally led delivery of humanitarian assistance. Soeripto is leading the organization’s U.S. delegation at UNGA81, focusing on child survival, nutrition, education and humanitarian diplomacy.

In an interview with The National, Save the Children U.S. head Janti Soeripto described the trauma of displacement experienced by children in Lebanon as family members, friends and homes are lost. She said the UN humanitarian appeal for Lebanon was only 20 per cent funded. Soeripto planned to attend the UN General Assembly that week to appeal for support for children in conflict zones.

The Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the 2020 Nobel Peace Prize to the World Food Programme for combating hunger, improving conditions for peace in conflict-affected areas and helping prevent hunger from being used as a weapon of war. The Committee emphasized that assistance to increase food security can improve prospects for stability and peace. It described the organization as playing a key role in multilateral cooperation.

question: Will New People (NL) win the third-most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
rules:
Parliamentary elections are scheduled to be held in Russia in September 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party that wins the third greatest number of seats in the next Russian State Duma election.

If the results are not known definitively by September 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The named parties or coalitions will be primarily ranked by the number of seats won in the specified election. If two or more parties are tied on seats, ties will be broken by the total number of valid votes received, with higher vote totals ranking higher. If parties remain tied, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the listed party abbreviations. This market will resolve to the party that occupies the third-highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the named party in the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation.

This market will resolve based on the results of this election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results reported by Russian g

evidence.excerpt: VTsIOM's September 11 release reports party support for August 31–September 6, 2026: United Russia 37.4%, CPRF 13.1%, New People 10.4%, LDPR 9.9%, and A Just Russia 4.5%. New People's support fell 1.1 percentage points from the preceding week, while LDPR gained 1.2 points. The survey used a combined telephone and household-interview sample of 1,600 adults, with a stated maximum error of 2.5%.

ExtremeScan's interim telephone survey conducted September 4–10 interviewed 800 Russian adults and reported a margin of error of ±3.5%. Among respondents naming a party, United Russia received 35.6%, CPRF 23.9%, New People 16.2%, LDPR 11.0%, and A Just Russia 5.9%. The report explicitly states that these are party-list voting preferences and that the single-mandate half of the Duma is not modelled.

FOM's preliminary election forecast gives United Russia 47–49%, CPRF 14–17%, LDPR 10–12%, New People 8–9%, and A Just Russia 6–7%. The accompanying text identifies United Russia as the expected leader, CPRF second and LDPR third. Its underlying September 4–6 household survey interviewed 1,500 adults in 97 settlements across 51 regions, with a stated maximum sampling error of 3.6%.

evidence.publisher: Moscow City Election Commission, reproducing Vedomosti reporting by Elena Mukhametshina
evidence.excerpt: A September 11 press digest reproduces Vedomosti's report that VTsIOM and FOM presented election forecasts on September 10. VTsIOM projected United Russia at 51–53%, CPRF at 13–15%, New People and LDPR each at 9–11%, and A Just Russia at 4–6%. FOM instead projected LDPR at 10–12% and New People at 8–9%.

Ksenia Smolyakova reports that New People was rapidly accumulating social-media reactions as Russians compared it with Yabloko. The monitoring covered VKontakte, MAX, Telegram and YouTube, with other major platforms excluded for technical reasons. The article reports that candidate exclusions and restrictions on competition had become major subjects of campaign discussion.

The article reports a large polling discrepancy: VTsIOM placed New People at 13.4%, whereas FOM measured 6%, behind CPRF and LDPR. It describes New People's regional network and grassroots participation as weak. It also notes that New People entered the Duma in 2021 with 5.3% of the vote.

question: Will Eric Barlow win the 2026 Wyoming Governor Republican primary election?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the Republican Primary for Governor of Wyoming, scheduled to take place on August 18, 2026. Resolution will be based on the overall winner of the primary, including any potential second round or run-off.

If no 2026 Wyoming Gubernatorial Republican Primary takes place, this market will resolve to “Other.”

The resolution source for this market will be the first official announcement of the results from the Wyoming Republican Party; however, an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

evidence.excerpt: His campaign released polling results Tuesday showing him at 42% support, followed by Degenfelder at 19% and Bien at 14% — with 22% undecided — when people were asked who they would vote for if the election were held today. The landline and cellphone call poll was taken from 400 likely Republican primary election voters and with a margin of error of 4.9%, according to the Barlow campaign. His campaign has amassed 2,500 volunteers and contributions from nearly 2,000 individual Wyoming donors, with more than $1 million raised from in-state individuals, the statement says.

Following an extensive grassroots evaluation process, the Wyoming Republican Party officially announces its platform-alignment endorsements for the upcoming Republican Primary Election. During its meeting, the State Central Committee evaluated candidate records, platform fidelity, and core conservative principles. Based on these evaluations, the Party endorses the following candidates for statewide leadership: Governor: Brent Bien.

The Wyoming Republican Party has endorsed Brent Bien for governor. Bien doesn’t have previous political experience, but decided to run in 2022 in response to Gov. Mark Gordon’s lockdown measures. In that year’s primary, he took about 30% of the vote to Gordon’s nearly 62%. Bien is running on the GOP ticket against three others: Megan Degenfelder, Eric Barlow and Curt Blake.

question: Will Kylian Mbappé win the Silver Ball at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
rules:
This market will resolve to the player who is awarded the Silver Ball award for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve according to the official winner as determined by FIFA rules. If multiple winners are announced then this market will resolve to the player whose listed last name comes first alphabetically.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is cancelled, postponed after August 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from FIFA; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

evidence.excerpt: The 2022 World Cup's best-player awards went to Lionel Messi (Golden Ball), Kylian Mbappé (Silver Ball), and Luka Modrić (Bronze Ball). Mbappé also won the Golden Boot with eight goals and received three player-of-the-match awards.

The adidas Golden Ball is presented to the best player at each FIFA World Cup finals. Those who finish as runners-up in the vote receive the adidas Silver Ball and Bronze Ball awards as the second and third most outstanding players in the tournament respectively. Only one man has won multiple adidas Golden Balls at the World Cup.

Croatia captain Luka Modric was awarded the adidas Golden Ball as the tournament's best player, while Belgium's Eden Hazard and France's Antoine Griezmann won the adidas Silver Ball and adidas Bronze Ball, respectively. England forward Harry Kane took home the adidas Golden Boot, finishing as top scorer with six goals, while France's teenage sensation Kylian Mbappe won the FIFA Young Player Award.

question: Will "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" score at least 90 on the Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer?
rules:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the displayed Rotten Tomatoes “All Critics” Tomatometer score for Spider-Man: Brand New Day (2026) is at least equal to the specified number at 10:00 AM ET on August 3, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If, for any reason, the resolution data is unavailable at this market's specified end time, the resolution source will be checked until the relevant data is available. This market will resolve to “No” if no data is available by August 7, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

evidence.excerpt: Currently, the movie stands at an impressive 90% with 111 reviews. That means the film is now "Certified Fresh" on the review site. As of now, Spider-Man: Far From Home is tied for third highest rated Spider-Man film on Rotten Tomatoes, with Spider-Man: Homecoming coming in second at 92%.

"No Way Home" boasts a 94% Rotten Tomatoes score and is opening in the weekend before Christmas with the expectation that it will perform well into the holiday. Jon Watts returns to direct the film, which was written by Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers.

Shang-Chi is directed and co-written by Destin Daniel Cretton, who broke through with the indie drama Short Term 12 which met rave reviews, and he most recently directed Just Mercy. The film is at 91% on Rotten Tomatoes, and critics widely praised it for having a strong dramatic core in addition to its eye popping action scenes.
